purpose: Structured clinician-reviewed point-of-care layer attached to each Gold Chapter.

investigations.test: e.g. X-ray Lumbosacral Spine AP & Lateral
investigations.indication: Persistent/mechanical back pain when imaging is clinically indicated

followUp: Reassessment timing, outcome measure, escalation/referral criteria

validationRules: No medication becomes GREEN/validated without source and clinician review.
Brand names are examples only and must be market-verified.
Emergency red flags override routine prescribing.
Check allergy, pregnancy/lactation, renal/hepatic status, age, comorbidities and interactions.
